Profiles and convergence

Method and limits

All methods use the same cold physical state, corrected Stadtke flux, safeguarded backward Euler, fixed residual policy and zero additional filter. The reference is the packaged perfect-gas shock_35 analytical solution. Errors compare conserved cell projections, not a hidden analytical initialization. Refinement results apply to this case only. All failures remain in the table and downloads.

Minmod is least compressive; Superbee selects the largest signed magnitude correctly for either sign. The selected Van Albada has an explicit extrema gate and safe inactive arithmetic. These piecewise smooth limiters do not guarantee Newton robustness or positivity for a coupled fluid system.

JSON records retain per-equation norms, budgets, boundary defects and final fields. Compile-inclusive elapsed times are not eligible for a speed comparison.
